priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore removal of the registered message listener
findings.body: The function previously returned a disposer that removed the exact handler registered by `attach`. Returning a no-op leaves the listener active after callers invoke cleanup, allowing stale handlers to process messages, accumulate across repeated attachment cycles, and retain referenced state.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns an empty disposer after line 2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler); the full diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler) with the no-op.
